# CiteSprint

> A productized GEO (generative engine optimization) sprint for developer tools and indie B2B SaaS founders who want to be named more often in AI answers to buyer questions.

CiteSprint is a personal service by Praveen Doddamani — not a funded GEO platform or ongoing SaaS dashboard.

## What it is
- One focused sprint (~10 business days after kickoff to draft handoff)
- Measured baseline of buyer prompts (win / tie / lose-style labels; null results allowed)
- FAQ + honest comparison (“vs”) pages delivered as markdown or a PR-ready artifact
- 2–3 ethical mention pitches (you send; typically under 10 minutes each)
- Contact: hello@citesprint.tech
- Site: https://citesprint.tech/

## Who it is for
- Indie developer-tool founders and small B2B SaaS teams
- Products with real buyer prompts (e.g. “best X for Y”) where AI shortlists matter
- Not a fit: consumer apps with no B2B prompts, brands already dominating every shortlist, or anyone needing a “guaranteed #1 in ChatGPT” promise

## Pricing ladder (USD, one-time)
1. $497 — founding (first 5; case-study rights)
2. $747 — next 10
3. From $997 — standard (up to ~$1,500 by scope, agreed in writing)

Risk reducer on paid sprints: if the baseline already shows you are named on most agreed target prompts, we stop and refund.

## What we measure
- How often your brand is named on agreed buyer prompts (including control prompts we do not try to improve)
- Each client report lists which assistants were actually used for that engagement
- Direct site checks when useful (robots.txt, /llms.txt, key URLs, schema)
- Practice / sample pages may also cite named third-party studies (e.g. Glotier ChatGPT+Gemini naming rates; Reditus ChatGPT citation maps) and clearly label inferred roundups

## What we do not claim
- No guarantee that ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews, or any assistant will name you
- No invented “we measured every engine on every prompt” claims
- No fake reviews, cloaking, spam links, or purchased AI-mention packages
- Technical files alone (robots, llms.txt, schema) do not fix rank by themselves
- Sample audits on public sites are practice examples — not customer case studies

## Free mini-audit
Request via the form on https://citesprint.tech/#contact or email hello@citesprint.tech with product URL/GitHub, top 2 competitors, and a work email.

## Key pages
- https://citesprint.tech/
- https://citesprint.tech/sample-audit.html
- https://citesprint.tech/cronhooks-sample.html — short practice sample (Oct 9, 2026 IST): Cronhooks described on a branded prompt by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Grok, but not named by ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity on 3 generic cron/webhook prompts. Not a customer; no affiliation.
- https://citesprint.tech/blog/ — AI visibility reviews: dated practice reviews of how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Grok recommend small developer tools (one run per prompt; not customers). RSS: https://citesprint.tech/blog/feed.xml
- https://citesprint.tech/checker.html — free self-serve checker: generates 5 buyer prompts for any dev tool, links to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Gemini, and a scoring guide (early / mid / late / not named). Runs client-side; no tracking.
- https://citesprint.tech/llms.txt

## Optional / out of scope
- Not ongoing social management, PPC, or a black-box monitoring SaaS
- Optional brief notes on llms.txt / JSON-LD only if useful — not a hero deliverable
